items.t: Optispark distributor failure (LT1)
items.job: Replace Optispark distributor
items.note: Parts: remanufactured units run about $70–$250 and new ones up to about $700; owners favor better-quality units for this part. Labor: one shop quoted 3.5 hours and owners say 4–5 hours for a first-timer; a forum poster puts shop labor at $600–$750, and another owner was quoted $1,500 total. Replace a leaking water pump at the same time, since it sits right above the distributor.

items.t: Coolant leaks and overheating (LT1)
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: Parts: ACDelco water pump for 1993–1997 5.7L Camaros (cheaper aftermarket pumps exist). No LT1 book time was found, so labor is based on YourMechanic’s 5.7L Camaro water pump estimate (about $555; shop range $631–$843) minus parts. Cost rises a lot if overheating damaged the head gaskets or the Optispark.

items.t: False low-coolant warning
items.job: Replace coolant level sensor

items.t: Slow, noisy or failed power windows
items.job: Replace power window motor or regulator
items.note: Price is per door. Worn glass run channels may also need replacing.

items.t: T-top roof leaks
items.job: Replace T-top weatherstrip seals
items.note: Drying wet carpet or fixing water-damaged wiring adds cost.

items.t: Dim or failing rear lights
items.job: Replace tail lamp bulb sockets
items.note: Price covers both sides. Melted or corroded wiring adds cost.

items.t: Weak welds near the driver door hinge (recall)
items.job: Install structural rivets near driver door hinge
items.note: Covered by a GM recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Seat belt retractor may not meet standards (recall)
items.job: Dealer inspects and replaces seat belt retractor under recall

items.t: Timing chain stretch (3.6L V6)
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners (3.6L V6)
items.note: Cost rises a lot if the chain jumped and damaged the engine.

items.t: Knee can knock the key out of Run (recall)
items.job: Replace flip key with fixed-blade keys and key rings
items.note: Free under GM's key recall. Check your VIN or ask a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Power seat can drop suddenly (recall)
items.job: Replace power seat height adjuster bolts
items.note: Free under GM's seat bolt recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Loose steering and control arm fasteners (recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque steering shaft and control arm fasteners
items.note: Covered by a GM recall for affected 2014 cars. Check your VIN.

items.t: Shudder from the 8-speed automatic
items.job: Full transmission fluid exchange with updated ATF (per bulletin)
items.note: If the fluid exchange does not cure it, a torque converter replacement costs much more.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall 23V-516)
items.job: Replace driver airbag inflator module
items.note: Free under recall 23V-516. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can come loose in an airbag deployment (recall 21V-211)
items.job: Secure or replace steering wheel emblem
items.note: Free under recall 21V-211. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear axle shaft can separate (recall 21V-188)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear axle shaft
items.note: Free under recall 21V-188. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump missing its pressure regulator can leak (recall 19V-837)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module
items.note: Free under recall 19V-837. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Seat belt anchor bolts may be the wrong ones (recall 20V-811)
items.job: Replace seat belt anchor bolts
items.note: Free under recall 20V-811. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water in the trunk damaging the rear fuse block
items.job: Find and seal the leak, install trunk drain (GM bulletin 18-NA-375) and replace the rear fuse block
items.note: Hours are GM’s 0.5-hour time for the drain plug only. Water testing the seals, repairing corroded wiring and swapping the fuse block add shop time on top. Fuse block price is for a 2016–2017 rear fuse box; a melted battery cable or damaged module costs more.

items.t: 10-speed automatic can lock the rear wheels (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
